plate_provenance.prompt:
Edit the provided image to remove all incandescence and thermal glowing effects, maintaining exact physical accuracy for Venus at 465°C (which is below the 525°C Draper point where thermal incandescence begins).

Keep the exact composition, camera angle, atmospheric lighting, background shield volcano, and the Soviet Venera-style planetary lander design:
1. Underneath the scalloped circular aerobrake collar: remove ALL red, orange, and yellow glowing light and self-luminous incandescence. The lower hull, cylindrical base, internal machinery, landing struts, and landing pads beneath the collar must be non-glowing, solid, weathered dark matte metallic titanium/steel in deep natural cast shadow under the overhang of the aerobrake collar.
2. Remove the red/orange reflection and glow under the spherical upper pressure hull.
3. Ground beneath the lander: completely eliminate the red-orange spotlight and pool of light on the rocks beneath the lander. The ground directly underneath the lander must be in dark, natural ambient shadow cast by the aerobrake collar and lander body.
4. Volcanic basalt rock field: remove ALL glowing red molten lava, glowing cracks, and hot embers between the foreground basalt rocks. All rocks must be cold, solid, dry, non-glowing, fractured dark brownish-grey basalt slabs and plates.
5. Lighting: Keep only the natural diffuse warm golden-amber and orange overhead lighting filtering down from the dense Venusian sulfuric acid cloud ceiling, illuminating the upper surfaces of the lander and landscape.
No text, no numbers, no logos, no robots.
